_about: Super Vega's agent roster: one place that lists every agent. The report (Iris), the workflow schematic and the SOP read it. Edit it when an agent is added, changed or retired. status: built | new | not ready | planned | decommissioned (not ready: built but not ready for production, the owner's word; decommissioned: removed from the system, kept on the roster for the record). styles: the Atlas designer styles an agent covers.

agents.name: Vega
agents.does: Takes the request, plans the batch herself, hands each video to its designer, reports progress, delivers the result, runs the helpers.

agents.name: Atlas
agents.does: Planning step of Vega's loop: batch sheet checks, designer choice and hand-off of each video; videos run in parallel, up to 6 at a time (2 rendering).

agents.name: Echo
agents.does: Writes scripts per brand writing style, with angle and phrasing repeat checks.

agents.name: Quill
agents.does: Turns a brand's site and notes into a DNA doc and hands Vega the brief.

agents.name: Hermes
agents.does: Uploads finished videos to Spira under the right tag. Never posts.

agents.name: Iris
agents.does: Builds the track sheet: targets, uploads, credits, skills used, storage and dev notes.

agents.name: Jani
agents.does: Backs up finished projects on the owner's word, checks every file, then clears them.

agents.name: Data Cleaner
agents.does: Archives failed attempts on a redo or cancel and frees numbers on a cancel.

agents.name: Talking Head Edited Designer
agents.does: 9:16 talking-head videos with Omni Flash 1.1 clips, b-roll, captions, SFX and music.

agents.name: Explainer Designer
agents.does: Narrated explainers over animated infographics, in any language.

agents.name: Podcast Designer
agents.does: Two AI co-hosts in conversation, lip-synced, cut like a podcast.

agents.name: Avatar Designer
agents.does: Avatar images only (Higgsfield Soul + GPT Image 2). The one source of personas and character sheets.

agents.name: Cloner
agents.does: Rebuilds a reference video's format for a brand with new lines, voice, persona and shots.

agents.name: Re-skit
agents.does: Re-skits a trending video: keeps the motion and voices (pitch-adjusted), recasts the person, changes the meaning.

agents.name: Corporate Carousel Designer
agents.does: 4–7 slide corporate brand carousels (1080×1350, 4:5) from a topic angle and the brand's website: research, design brief, copy, GPT Image 2 assets, HTML layout, rendered JPEGs and captions.

agents.name: Lifestyle Story Carousel Designer
agents.does: 5–10 slide photoreal lifestyle story carousels (4:5 feed or 9:16 story) with no script: picks its own idea per client, researches pains, locks one person and place (Soul + GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1), real product UI on screens, local grade and text, 6-check self-grade, captions. Rey's Carousel Skill V2.

agents.name: Repurpose
agents.does: Made repurposed cuts of a finished video. Hardly used (1 cut, Cookiy, October); removed from the system on 2026-10-24 (the owner's decision).
